description:
Brand Introduction:

Airy Fragrances brings the finest Japanese scent experience to your audience, offering alcohol-free, perfume-inspired scents in reed diffusers and 100% natural crystal stone diffusers.

Each product is thoughtfully crafted to showcase nature’s beauty with scents that feel natural and luxurious. With unique packaging and a presence in top publications like Vogue, The Luxe Review,  Confidential and more. 


Product Description:

Our collection includes both reed diffusers and 100% natural crystal stone diffusers, each designed to fill any space with captivating, luxurious aromas. These scents are inspired by high-end perfumes, offering a subtle yet refined fragrance experience.

The natural crystal stone diffusers emphasise purity and elegance, making them a perfect addition to any luxury home. Each product comes in beautiful, unique packaging, making it the ideal gift or home accent.


USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Alcohol-free, high-quality Japanese-made fragrances with special Japanese reeds, made for those who value permuim quality,

  • Perfume-inspired scents loved by customers that make any home smell delightful, featured in top luxury publications.

  • Unique packaging that stands out, enhancing the gifting experience and adding an extra touch of sophistication.

  • Enjoy luxury Japanese fragrance with 48-hour tracked delivery: Orders placed by 11 AM are dispatched the same day, ensuring fast and efficient delivery to your audience.

  • No need to smell before purchasing online – every scent smells amazing, unfolding layers of fragrance to surprise and delight your audience.

Payment Terms:

Earn 15% commission on every sale with monthly payments and fast, easy transfers. (Commission is negotiable).


Programme Details

  • Active for 3 months from the date we dispatch your gift
  • If you’d like to continue after 3 months, just let us know! Otherwise, the link will deactivate automatically
  • Exclusively for UK-based affiliates
  • Brand Integrity Matters – If any affiliate link or promotional method violates our luxury brand image, it may not be approved or could be removed from the programme.


Other Information:

  • Fast response times and quick transfers ensure affiliates are always supported and paid without delay.

  • Promote a luxury brand that resonates with affluent UK consumers, attracting big spenders who appreciate high-quality, exclusive products.

  • Influencers receive a special gift – your favourite scent, straight from our exclusive collection, to indulge in and share with your followers.

  • Earn passive income with luxury scents, while increasing your authentic and unique style, perfect for those who love luxury and lifestyle.
